evidence: Before the change: `uv run -q --with textual --with pytest --with pytest-xdist python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k phase_task -n 4` gave 5 failed (all 5 new phase_task tests). After the change: the same -k phase_task run plus phase_detail/test_p_ gave 9 passed. Full `tests/test_dashboard_app.py -n 4` gave 182 passed, including the 60-column footer test. Tmux run `uv run -q --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests -q -m tmux -rf` (serial) gave 11 passed, 356 deselected.
observations: I added PhaseTaskList, an OptionList subclass, in scripts/dashboard_app.py. It replaces the `#phase-tasks` Static and keeps the same id and the "Tasks" panel style. A refresh keeps the highlighted task by id. j/k and up/down move through tasks, and each move scrolls `#phase` so the highlighted task stays visible. PhaseDetailScreen.on_option_list_option_selected stops the event and pushes TaskDetailScreen(self.target, task_id). Enter and click both open the task, and the app's open_task/check_action stay untouched. phase_task_line (one Text per task) replaces phase_task_lines. Focus choice: AUTO_FOCUS stays "#phase". After the first load, the task list takes focus with scroll_visible=False, so the screen opens at the top with the title shown. The list rebinds pageup/pagedown/home/end to scroll `#phase`, so page keys still scroll the whole phase detail. The focused list shows a round $accent border. Esc from the task detail pops back to the phase detail; app.focus_tasks returns early there, and Textual restores the list's focus and highlight. Tests check all of this. Tests: 3 new phase_task tests (5 cases with the size parametrisation): arrows move, enter opens the task and esc returns, page keys scroll. I changed the existing test_p_on_a_header test to read option prompts instead of Static.render().
